youtube_title: Sold a Policy You Don't Need? Return It in 30 Days. Rules You Didn't Know #12 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #12. An agent sold you an insurance policy and at home you realise you never needed it. Can you return it? A: no, the money's gone. B: yes, in the free-look period.
Answer: B. Under IRDAI's 2024 rules, life and health insurance policies come with a 30-day free-look period from the day you receive the policy document. Cancel without giving a reason and the premium is refunded, minus a small deduction for the days you were covered, medical tests and stamp duty. Send the request in writing and keep proof of the date.
Education only, not financial advice.
Source: IRDAI regulations and master circulars, 2024.
